# catalystcenter_application (Data Source)

This data source can read the Application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalystcenter_application" "example" {
  id   = "my-custom-app"
  name = "my-custom-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) The name of the application

### Read-Only

- `app_protocol` (String) Transport protocol the application runs over
- `application_set_id` (String) ID of the application set this application belongs to. Only `idRef` is sent on update; the `id` that `GET` returns alongside it must not be echoed back.
- `application_sub_type` (String) Server-assigned application subtype, echoed back on update
- `category_id` (String) ID of the application category. The controller exposes no endpoint to list categories, so this opaque UUID must be copied from an existing application in the desired category.
- `display_name` (String) Server-assigned display name, echoed back on update
- `dscp` (String) DSCP value assigned to traffic matching this application
- `engine_id` (String) Classification engine. Custom applications use `6`. The controller accepts an application without it, but the GUI then fails to render the application's IP/Port classifier.
- `help_string` (String) Description of the application shown in the GUI
- `instance_id` (Number) Server-assigned instance ID, echoed back on update
- `instance_version` (Number) Server-assigned instance version, echoed back on update
- `namespace` (String) Server-assigned namespace, echoed back on update
- `network_application_display_name` (String) Server-assigned display name of the nested network application
- `network_application_id` (String) Server-assigned ID of the nested network application, echoed back on update
- `network_application_name` (String) Server-assigned name of the nested network application, echoed back on update
- `network_identity` (Attributes Set) Optional L3/L4 signatures identifying the application (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_identity))
- `popularity` (Number) Server-assigned popularity, echoed back on update
- `qualifier` (String) Server-assigned qualifier, echoed back on update
- `rank` (Number) Rank used to break ties between overlapping applications
- `scalable_group_external_handle` (String) Server-assigned external handle, echoed back on update
- `selector_id` (String) Server-assigned selector ID, echoed back on update
- `server_name` (String) Server name identifying the application, when `server_type` is `_servername`
- `server_type` (String) How the application is identified. `_servername` pairs with `server_name`, `_url` with `url`.
- `traffic_class` (String) The traffic class the application is assigned to
- `url` (String) URL identifying the application, when `server_type` is `_url`

<a id="nestedatt--network_identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_identity`

Read-Only:

- `ipv4_subnet` (Set of String) IPv4 subnets matching the application
- `lower_port` (Number) Start of a port range, used with `upper_port`. Leave `ports` empty when a range is used. The controller returns `0` when no range is set.
- `ports` (String) Comma separated list of discrete ports. A hyphenated range is rejected by the controller; use `lower_port` and `upper_port` for a range. The controller requires this key to be present even when empty, so send an empty string when only a range is used.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the signature
- `upper_port` (Number) End of a port range, used with `lower_port`. Leave `ports` empty when a range is used. The controller returns `0` when no range is set.
